cadence_rationale: Two states reflect actual source change behavior without multiplying redundant captures: a stable daily schedule/early quote state and a final pregame state for market/goalie changes.
collision_policy: CREATE_NEW_ONLY; exclusive creation fails if run_id or path exists; never update/replace
immutability: Every later state creates a new run and source event; earlier files are read-only.
late_run_policy: Any game with run_timestamp_utc >= scheduled_start_time_utc is excluded from pregame populations and recorded POST_START_REJECTED.

run_types.FINAL_PREGAME: Per-game or start-time cohort snapshot targeted 30 minutes before scheduled start; never after start.
run_types.MIDDAY: One slate-wide observation after the official daily schedule is loaded; intended to preserve an earlier market state.

timestamp_standard: UTC RFC3339 with six fractional digits and Z
